schema.appeal.decision_ref.label: Which decision are you appealing?
schema.appeal.decision_ref.help: Pick it from your notices. The reference is filled in for you when you start from a notice.
schema.appeal.rule_ids_disputed.label: Which rules do you think were misapplied? (optional)
schema.appeal.rule_ids_disputed.help: Leave this empty if you do not know. The notice lists the rules that were used.
schema.appeal.what_is_wrong.label: What is wrong with the decision?
schema.appeal.what_is_wrong.help: Say which fact or which reading you think is wrong. Plain words are fine.
schema.appeal.outcome_sought.label: What outcome are you asking for?
schema.appeal.outcome_sought.help: For example: publish the post, or look at the decision again.
schema.appeal.new_evidence_refs.label: New evidence (optional)
schema.appeal.new_evidence_refs.help: Only add what was not in the original post. Never add new personal data about anyone.
schema.appeal.new_evidence_refs.url.help: Starts with http or https. Do not link to anything showing a private person.
